about.title: About PhotoHub
about.desc: PhotoHub connects clients seeking memorable photography with top-tier verified photographers. We simplify scheduling, package selection, transparent payment processing, and quality assurance.

helpCenter.faq1Q: How do I download my photos?
helpCenter.faq1A: Once your booking status is 'Confirmed' and the shoot is over, a 'Client Delivery Portal' toggle will appear on your Dashboard.
helpCenter.faq2A: You can cancel up to 48 hours before the event for a full refund. Cancellations within 48 hours incur a 50% fee.
helpCenter.faq3A: Yes. We use industry-standard encryption. Funds are held in escrow and released to the photographer only after the event.
helpCenter.faq4A: Refunds are processed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days after admin approval.

legal.title: Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
legal.section1Desc: By accessing and using PhotoHub's marketplace, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. This includes our photographer verification processes, payment holding rules, and image licensing agreements.
legal.section2Desc: All bookings made through the platform are secured via our payment gateway. Funds are held in escrow and released to the photographer only after the event date and initial proofs are delivered.
legal.section3Desc: We collect minimal data necessary to facilitate your bookings. Your personal information, payment details, and event locations are encrypted. We do not sell your data to third parties. Uploaded portfolios remain the intellectual property of the respective photographers.
